content.rendered: Construction continues to take place at SMS as contractors work to finish by the end of August.  Although we cannot use our building, SMS office staff have been temporarily located in the Share/SHIP portable.  Please look for the “Temporary Office” sign in the SMS parking lot near the tennis courts.  Phones, fax, and email continue to work as normal.
